finding: The v2 fixture can block no-method when the arm is followed, but one no-method trial selected Y and reported conflict with higher-priority WeiLan bootstrap/workspace instructions. This makes no-method arm execution not clean enough for R6 calibration on this surface.
decision: stop remaining v2 trials; do not claim redesigned cross-window calibration; next fix must isolate no-method execution from mandatory WeiLan bootstrap or use a separate non-method executor surface with equivalent telemetry.
